data.representation: one PCA transform fit on MNIST training data; 2^n features; per-sample L2 normalization for amplitude encoding

model.ansatz: independent RY/RZ plus nearest-neighbor CNOT chain
model.classifier_readout: Pauli-Z expectations on qubits 0 and 1 plus softmax
model.candidate_measurement_scope: same-axis Pauli products on the two readout qubits; ZZ/XX/YY is not tomographically complete
model.readout_qfi_reference: SLD QFI of the two-readout-qubit reduced density matrix; an upper bound for that subsystem, not a jointly attainable multiparameter CFI

descriptive_correlations.warning: Exploratory only: seed-method points are not independent and do not support population-level inference
